thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — p99 latency crossing threshold for route /v1/infer in us-west-2 (p99=420ms, SLO=300ms). Trigger: 3m sustained. Graph: https://metrics/redwood/ingest/1718902468

alex (oncall): acked. I'm digging into hot paths. Can someone check autoscaler and recent deploys?

maya: saw a small deploy 5m ago to model-router; checking rollout. No errors in deploy logs yet.

sam: looking at autoscaler — no recent scale events, pods at ~88% GPU util on pool-gpu-1. Could be queue backlog.

alex (oncall): queue backlog sounds plausible. What's traffic like? Any customer spike?

opsbot: Recent traffic: +22% qps for /v1/infer from apac-edge -> routed to us-west-2 due to regional weights. Top callers: internal-loadtest, partner-sync.

maya: internal-loadtest spike is expected; someone started a batch run. Can we reroute partner traffic to dedicated pool or rate-limit the loadtest?

sam: quick mitigation: set route weight for apac-edge -> us-west-2 down 50% to force more regional routing. Applying now.

alex (oncall): doing short checklist — start warm KV cache, enable fallback smaller model if latency persists, and throttle internal-loadtest at edge.

maya: warm KV cache command: `curl -X POST https://ops/redwood/cache/warm?route=/v1/infer` — running. Also can push model-fallback policy: set fallback=model-quant-8 on route. Want me to apply?

alex (oncall): yes apply fallback after 30s if p99 > 350ms. Create a canary: 10% traffic.

sam: autoscaler triggered a small scale +1 node, but provisioning taking ~45s. We should see improvement in ~60-90s.

incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: PAGER FIRED -> PD-INC-7812 (oncall-alex). If unacked > 2m will escalate.

alex (oncall): I have the pager. acking PD-INC-7812.

maya: applied fallback canary (10%) to route. Monitoring.

opsbot: Telemetry update: p99 dropped to 360ms after canary, tail still elevated. KV warm completed, hit rate on kv-cache increased 2.3x.

sam: backend queue length decreased after scale. Node joined pool. GPU util now 72%. Sweet spot.

alex (oncall): good. Keep monitoring 10m. If p99 < 320ms for 5m, I'll close alert. Notify customer-impact if partner-sync saw errors.

maya: partner-sync logs show 2xx mostly, 0.2% 429s during peak weight change. Sending mail to partner ops.

incident-bot: ALERT RESOLVED — p99 back under threshold for 3m. Auto-close scheduled in 10m unless reopened.

alex (oncall): closing from my side in 30m after postmortem notes. Thanks team :heart:

sam: filing short-runbook note: root cause = regional traffic spike from internal-loadtest + delayed scale. Mitigations = weight reroute, KV warm, fallback canary, autoscaler tuning. Will create follow-up ticket.

maya: noted. I'll add deploy rollback option to the runbook in case model-router rollout correlates next time.

alex (oncall): final: impact = transient latency SLO burn (~10% threshold breach for 6m). Customer-facing impact low; one partner saw brief 429s. Postmortem + action items assigned to sam/maya.

opsbot: PD-INC-7812 closed by alex (oncall).
